title: agrostis borealis var. californica
intro: Agrostis borealis var. californica, commonly known as California bentgrass, is a type of grass native to the western coast of North America. It is primarily used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating various respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of California bentgrass include its ability to relieve inflammation and soothe irritated mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
